subject: Re: Project Sirocco kickoff - staffing and compute
body:
Ximena,

Resourcing for Sirocco:

- Staffing: Wanjiru 60%, Fumiko 50%, Nikhil 40% through late May. No hiring ask.
- Compute: light - CelebA attribute classifiers train on single GPUs, so a 12-16 GPU slice of titan-a100 best-effort covers the repro matrix (attributes x target FPRs x sigmoid temperatures). The internal-classifier phase runs on the owning teams' existing training setups, we just bring the ICO loss.
- Data access: the two internal screening classifiers involve sensitive data, so I've filed the Privacy Review paperwork already - their 2-3 week SLA means clearance should land just as the CelebA repro finishes. Filed under the Sirocco codename per your doc-tagging note.

One planning caution: the second internal classifier's owning team is mid-reorg; if their eval infra isn't stable by early April I'd rather drop to one internal case than rush two. Flagging now so it's not a surprise in the memo.

Ivo
